title: 12-Layer Stack with Perturbed Initialization and Outer Layer Clamping
scientific_hypothesis: Optimization stagnation in rounds 2-3 caused performance regression; re-initializing thicknesses near 440 nm with controlled perturbation and clamping outer layers will recover impedance matching and improve target score.
design_principle: Impedance matching at air-film and film-substrate interfaces via outer layer thickness control, combined with stochastic initialization to escape local minima.
proposed_topology: 12 finite layers: HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2
manufacturing_considerations: Outer layers (indices 0, 1, 10, 11) clamped to tighter bounds
expected_advantages: Escaping local minima via perturbed initialization
known_risks: Optimization may converge to local minima similar to prior rounds
Tighter bounds may restrict global optimum search
execution_request_english: Optimize the thicknesses of a 12-layer planar stack consisting of alternating HfO2 and SiO2 layers on a Silicon substrate with Air incidence at 0 degrees. Target high absorptance in 8000-13000 nm and low absorptance in 3000-5000 nm. Initialize thicknesses at 440 nm +/- 20 nm random perturbation. Enforce tighter thickness bounds on outer layers (indices 0, 1, 10, 11) to preserve entrance/exit interface impedance matching. Use Adam optimizer with reduced learning rate to dampen oscillatory thickness drift. Evaluate absorptance via Transfer Matrix Method. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 3000-5000 nm, 8000-13000 nm. soft objectives: high emissivity in 8000-13000 nm; low emissivity in 3000-5000 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high emissivity in 3000-5000 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 24.
revision_reason: Adjusting optimization parameters per feedback directive to recover performance lost in iterations 2-3.
